name: activity-rings
title: Activity rings
description: Closing rings for goal-tracking metrics: one band per metric, swept up from empty on mount and eased to every later reading. Rings nest as concentric full circles — where beating a goal laps the track and keeps the completed lap at full strength behind the leading arc — or split one circle into segments weighted by their goals. The first three bands take the closing-ring trio's own tokens, a named set of roles rather than three slots of the categorical chart ramp, and each role carries both a band step and the ink step a legend writes its name in; a fourth ring onward continues into that ramp's solid step. Slots are assigned in input order, so one always names the same metric, and the readings reach a screen reader as an off-screen list rather than as undescribed shapes. ActivityRingsCard pairs the rings, or any component put in their place, with a per-metric legend inside a Card — beside the figure or listed beneath it — and keeps the highlight on the figure and its legend row in step.
